summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Open Badges 2.0 implementation for Ernesto Couso's academic credentials. All backend endpoints working correctly with proper Open Badges 2.0 compliance, privacy protection, and frontend verification pages fully functional.
passed_tests: Backend: Issuer endpoint returns valid Issuer JSON
Backend: All 3 badge classes return valid BadgeClass JSON with correct metadata
Backend: All 3 assertions return valid Assertion JSON with hosted verification and hashed recipients (sha256)
Backend: All 3 badge images return valid PNG files (600x600)
Backend: All 3 baked PNGs return valid PNG files with embedded assertion URLs
Backend: All 3 public view endpoints return complete credential data
Backend: 404 responses for unknown slugs/aids work correctly
Privacy: No DOB (1977-09-29 or September 29, 1977) in any endpoint response
Privacy: No student ID (8006239593) in any endpoint response
PhD badge: Description and criteria correctly state 'degree not yet conferred'
Frontend: All 3 credential verify pages load with correct data-testid elements
Frontend: Badge images display correctly on all pages
Frontend: Credential names, facts, and disclaimers display correctly
Frontend: Download buttons link to correct baked.png files
Frontend: Copy link buttons present and functional
Frontend: JSON links point to correct assertion endpoints
Frontend: Page URLs display correctly (https://210codelabs.com/credentials/{aid})
Frontend: Meta robots tags set to 'noindex, nofollow' on all credential pages
Frontend: No canonical links on credential pages (correct for noindex)
Frontend: Bogus credential ID shows NotFound page
Regression: Homepage loads without errors
Regression: /blog page loads without errors
Regression: /book page loads without errors
